meta.author_role: Research Coordinator and Product Specification Architect

evidence_tags.official_fact: Verified directly on an official JLPT page (jlpt.jp) during research.
evidence_tags.secondary_source: Reported by non-official sources; not independently verified.
evidence_tags.research_backed: Supported by cited research or documentation; interpretation is ours.
evidence_tags.design_decision: A decision made in this specification; adjustable by the owner.
evidence_tags.assumption: An assumption that has not been verified.
evidence_tags.unresolved: Open question that must be investigated before or during implementation.

requirement_levels.MUST: Mandatory for release 1.0 unless explicitly moved to a documented limitation.
requirement_levels.SHOULD: Strongly recommended; may be deferred with a written reason.

meta.honesty_clause: No section of this specification may be used to claim that content is validated, complete, or official unless the corresponding content_status and coverage fields say so.

source_register.claim: JLPT test sections and test times per level: N1 110+55, N2 105+50, N3 30+70+40, N4 25+55+35, N5 20+40+30 minutes. Listening time may differ slightly with recording length. N4/N5 times changed Dec 2020; N1 listening changed to 55 min from Dec 2022.

Scoring sections, ranges, overall pass marks (N1 100, N2 90, N3 95, N4 90, N5 80 of 180) and sectional pass marks (19/60; N4-N5 language+reading 38/120, listening 19/60). Failing any scoring section fails the test.
JLPT does not include sections that directly measure speaking or writing; machine-scored; uses scaled (equated) scores rather than raw scores.

Test item types per section and level (e.g. Kanji reading, Orthography, Contextually-defined expressions, Paraphrases, Usage, Sentential grammar 1/2, Text grammar, reading comprehension types, listening item types).

CEFR level indication on score reports begins December 2025, only for passers; mapping N1 100-141 B2, 142+ C1; N2 90-111 B1, 112+ B2; N3 95-103 A2, 104+ B1; N4 90+ A2; N5 80+ A1. No indication for Production or Interaction.
source_register.confidence: high (mapping figures seen in official snippet and secondary copies)

source_register.claim: Official sample questions exist per level (one sample per item type, may differ from real booklets) and two Official Practice Workbooks (2012, Vol.2 2018) are published, containing questions selected from past tests.

No official vocabulary/kanji/grammar list has been published since the 2010 revision; the organizers state publishing content specifications was judged not appropriate. All level lists are therefore unofficial.

Unofficial size estimates by level (N5 ~800 words and ~80-103 kanji; N4 roughly +70 kanji; N3 ~650 kanji and ~3,500 words; N2 ~1,000 kanji and ~6,000 words; N1 ~2,000 kanji and ~10,000 words) vary between sources.

GitHub Pages limits: published site <= 1 GB, source repo recommended <= 1 GB, soft 100 GB/month bandwidth, soft 10 builds/hour (not applicable to custom Actions workflow), deployments time out at 10 minutes. Project sites live at https://<user>.github.io/<repo>/.
localStorage is synchronous, string-only, roughly 5 MB per origin, unavailable to workers and service workers; Cache Storage/IndexedDB recommended for large data.

Safari applies a 7-day cap on script-writable storage (incl. localStorage, IndexedDB, service worker registrations) after 7 days of Safari use without interaction; Home Screen web apps are exempt and have their own isolated storage.

iOS has no beforeinstallprompt; users install via Share > Add to Home Screen; Web Push on iOS needs Home Screen install (iOS 16.4+). Android Chrome offers an install prompt when manifest/HTTPS criteria are met.
Browsers block audible autoplay until a user gesture; on iOS Safari an AudioContext starts suspended and must be resumed inside a gesture handler.

Web Speech speechSynthesis ja-JP depends on installed OS/browser voices; offline only for local voices (localService); voice lists load asynchronously; some voices truncate long utterances (~14 s bug reported); downloadable iOS voices may not be listed.

Meta-analytic evidence: spaced vs massed practice g=0.74 (spaced retrieval); expanding vs uniform spacing no significant difference (g=0.034); interleaving g~0.42; retrieval practice g~0.50 with large heterogeneity.

FSRS is an open DSR-model scheduler adopted by Anki 23.10 as an alternative to SM-2; reference implementations are open source (MIT for several ports; verify each package license). Benchmark superiority figures in third-party READMEs are unverified here.

EDRDG dictionary files (JMdict, KANJIDIC2) are licensed CC BY-SA (EDRDG licence page states V4.0; some redistributions cite 3.0); KANJIDIC has extra conditions; KanjiVG is CC BY-SA 3.0; Tatoeba sentences are commonly CC BY 2.0 FR (some CC0); Tanos JLPT lists are CC BY and unofficial.
source_register.confidence: medium; re-verify each licence text before bundling

source_register.claim: Gamification evidence for Duolingo-style streaks/XP/leagues is mostly self-report surveys and company-reported figures; students report both motivation and frustration (streak loss, competitive pressure, repetition).

Many field recordings of stations exist on Freesound under CC0, but Japan-specific CC0 availability was not confirmed; commercial Japan ambience libraries (Sonniss, A Sound Effect, Artlist, Gumroad) are paid/licensed and must not be redistributed in a public repo.
Reddit and community forums were not directly accessed in this research pass (search tool returned WaniKani/Bunpro/Anki community threads only). Community-derived points are anecdotal.

product_vision.one_liner: A free, offline-first, private PWA in which learning Japanese from zero to JLPT N1 is experienced as a progressively unlocked journey through Japan.
product_vision.organizing_concept: Explore Japan is the home screen and the organizing metaphor. Every lesson belongs to a destination; every destination is gated by educational prerequisites, never by geography.

three_areas.explore_japan: Illustrated stylized SVG map, destinations, stamps, postcards, travel journal, optional procedurally generated ambience.
three_areas.learn_japanese: Curriculum, daily plan, exercises, SRS reviews, kana/kanji/vocab/grammar/listening/reading/typing/handwriting self-practice, speaking practice (record and compare, no scoring).
three_areas.jlpt_preparation: Level plans, official-structure timed section practice and mock exams, readiness dashboard, weakness analysis.

product_vision.shared_state_rule: All three areas read the same local progress model. Destination completion never implies JLPT proficiency; a practice result never implies official certification.
product_vision.tone: Calm, colorful, rewarding, uncluttered. Original visual identity; no third-party mascots or branding.
product_vision.motivation_hook: The learner has visited Japan; familiar scenes (stations, konbini, streets) and optional ambience are used as emotional anchors, while language content stays level-appropriate.

objectives.learner_goal: Absolute beginner to JLPT N1-level ability, with practical skills beyond exam performance.
success_measures: Learner can complete the core daily session in <= 30 minutes and optional extension up to 60 minutes.
Review accuracy after 30+ days for items marked stable >= 85% (measured locally).
Learner can see at any time where they are in Japan, what to do next, and what is locked.

user_profile.location: India (examination dates and test-centre availability are the learner's responsibility; the app only stores a target date).
user_profile.prior_experience: Has visited Japan; no Japanese knowledge assumed.
user_profile.motivation: International career opportunities; familiarity and emotional connection with Japanese environments.
user_profile.romaji_policy: Shown as scaffolding for unlearned kana; fades per learner mastery (see learning_engine.romaji_fade).

hard.text: Zero recurring cost; no paid subscriptions, paid infrastructure, or paid APIs.
No AI/model API calls from the deployed app. All personalization is deterministic and rules-based.
Static site only: no backend, no hosted database, no accounts.
Host on GitHub Pages as a project site under a repository sub-path; no root-path assumptions.
Work on Android and iPhone (documented platform limitations) and desktop browsers.
Offline-capable after required resources are cached; never claim an asset is offline until the cache has verified it.
User progress and settings are stored in localStorage; IndexedDB must not be introduced silently (see decisions D-003).
JSON export/import with validation, preview, overwrite warning, confirmation, and non-destructive failure.
JLPT N5-N1 are all represented in architecture and have working learning functionality; unreleased content is labeled, never faked.
Explore Japan is the central organizing experience, including stylized SVG map, destinations, stamps, journal.
Environmental audio is original or has a verified license permitting redistribution in a public repo; unclear rights means exclude.
Original visual identity; no third-party mascots, logos, or protected artwork.
Spaced repetition and adaptive planning run locally with deterministic, testable rules.
No placeholder or repetitive filler content; items that are not real are not shipped as content.
Target of >= 20 distinct full-length mock exams per level is a recorded long-term goal; release 1.0 ships only what is genuinely distinct and reviewed (see mock_examinations).
No fabricated official JLPT claims, scores, or scoring formulas; practice results are labeled as practice estimates.
No unauthorized copyrighted material (textbooks, question banks, official JLPT questions, commercial audio, protected characters).
No dishonest claims about testing, validation, coverage, or functionality, in the app UI or in repository documentation.
Audio must start only after a user gesture where required; ambience is off by default; study in silence loses nothing.
Speaking: optional local recording and playback only; never upload; no accuracy scoring claims. App fully works without a microphone.
Handwriting is self-assessed and labeled as such; typing is auto-checked.
Accessibility: contrast, touch targets, keyboard support, screen-reader labels, reduced-motion, non-color correctness cues.
No telemetry, analytics, or trackers; no external requests required for core function.
Missed days never shame the learner; comeback session caps backlog.
Educational prerequisites are authoritative for unlocking destinations and levels; geography never bypasses them.
Each content item carries provenance, license, review status; third-party assets recorded in the asset manifest.
Content status is shown to the learner (draft, auto_checked, human_reviewed); unreviewed content is labeled.

recommended.text: Use plain HTML/CSS/ES modules with a tiny build step (Vite optional) to minimize dependencies.
Provide a first-run 2-minute placement tour, not a long settings wizard.
Weekly consistency goal (e.g. 4 of 7 days) as the primary habit indicator; daily streak optional.
Procedural Web Audio ambience as baseline; optional verified CC0 recordings as opt-in packs.
Offer a Home Screen install nudge on iOS explaining storage persistence benefits.
Quarterly content batches adding reviewed mock exams (1 per level per batch).

optional.text: Pre-generated native or open-licensed TTS audio packs for core vocabulary and dialogues.
Dark mode and font-size options beyond defaults.
Printable travel-journal export (self-generated PDF via print stylesheet).

decisions.conflict: Brief wants >=20 distinct full-length mocks per level (>=100 total). Each full mock is on the order of 100 items; 100 mocks = roughly 10,000 unique reviewed items plus listening audio. Without a native reviewer and licensed audio this cannot be delivered at honest quality in release 1.
decisions.resolution: Keep 20/level as the long-term target in the spec and architecture. Release 1.0 ships a floor of mock exams per level that are fully distinct and have at least auto_checked status, plus section-practice sets. UI shows 'N of 20 mocks released' per level. Items must never be shuffled and re-labeled as new exams.
decisions.assumption: Item count per mock is approximate and must be re-derived from official sample materials (unresolved U-002).

decisions.conflict: Learners expect 'N5 word lists' but none are official (S07).
decisions.resolution: Every level tag on vocabulary/kanji/grammar is stored as instructional_level and rendered with the label 'Instructional level (unofficial)'. Official facts are limited to structure, timing, scoring marks, item types.

decisions.conflict: localStorage is sync, string-only, ~5 MB, not worker-accessible (S10).
decisions.resolution: Keep localStorage. Budget: total user state <= 1.5 MB (hard warning at 3.0 MB, estimated headroom vs ~5 MB). Shard keys by domain and SRS bucket; store compact arrays; cap logs. Document trigger: if measured usage > 3.5 MB or a write throws QuotaExceededError, first compact (drop oldest attempt logs, merge shards), then prompt the user to export; only after explicit owner approval may a minimal IndexedDB fallback for attempt logs be considered. No silent switch.

decisions.conflict: Safari tabs can lose script-writable storage after 7 days of Safari use without visiting (S11).
decisions.resolution: Strongly recommend Home Screen install on iPhone; show non-blocking banner; periodic export reminders (every 7 study days or when last export > 14 days). navigator.storage.persist() requested where available but not relied upon.

decisions.conflict: Fashionable frameworks vs maintainability on Claude Code and GitHub Pages.
decisions.resolution: Vanilla ES modules with small hand-written view helpers and JSON content files, built with Vite (dev dependency only) and validated by Node scripts. A UI framework (e.g. Preact) is allowed only with a written justification. Rationale: tiny bundle, cache-friendly, no framework lock-in, simple service worker precache manifest.

decisions.conflict: Authentic Japanese field recordings are mostly licensed/paid (S19); jingles are protected.
decisions.resolution: Baseline ambience is synthesized procedurally with Web Audio (filtered noise for rain/wind, rhythmic rail clack, generic two-tone chimes, footsteps) = original, ~0 KB. Optional recorded packs only if license is verified CC0 or CC BY (no NC, no ND restrictions that block adaptation, no SA contamination of the code repo) and recorded in asset_manifest. Never reproduce departure melodies, convenience-store jingles, or real announcements.

decisions.conflict: Static PWA cannot call TTS APIs; pre-recorded native audio is unavailable without recording or a verified-license TTS toolchain; Web Speech voices vary by device and offline availability (S14).
decisions.resolution: Release 1.0 learning audio = Web Speech ja-JP with device voice detection, chunking under ~12 s, rate control (0.6-1.0), clear 'synthetic voice, quality varies by device' labeling, and a graceful no-voice fallback (read-only text, audio exercises hidden/replaced). Optional pre-generated audio packs are an expansion item (U-001). Listening exercises and mocks are labeled synthetic and not exam-realistic.

Content ships in versioned batches with content_status progression: draft -> auto_checked -> human_reviewed. Only auto_checked or higher appears in mocks. Coverage percentages are computed from the manifest at build time and displayed in-app.

decisions.conflict: Streak/XP/competition boosts consistency but can create guilt/frustration (S18). No backend, so no leaderboards.
decisions.resolution: Keep: weekly consistency ring, XP as a local progress readout, stamps/postcards, achievements tied to learning evidence, review mastery bars. Drop: hearts/lives, leaderboards, paid freezes. Streak is optional, with auto grace days. Rewards require evidence-based completion (accuracy + retrieval), never just opening the app.

decisions.conflict: SM-2 simple but weaker; FSRS stronger but needs careful implementation (S15-S16).
decisions.resolution: Implement FSRS-4.5-style DSR scheduling with default parameters from published equations in a small local module (no optimizer), 4 grades mapped from correctness + confidence + latency; target retention 0.90 default (0.85-0.95 adjustable), per-card fuzz disabled for determinism, hard cap on daily new/review load. If implementation correctness cannot be demonstrated by unit tests against published reference vectors (U-003), fall back to a documented Leitner-style scheduler.

Original stylized SVG with simplified coastlines and inset for Okinawa; positions computed from real lat/lon via fixed projection, with documented manual offsets; map labeled 'stylized, not for navigation'.

decisions.conflict: Educational prerequisites must be authoritative but learners may already know material.
decisions.resolution: Level N+1 unlocks only via curriculum threshold AND a passed readiness check. A 'placement challenge' (timed, high-stakes quiz of N+1 prerequisites) can satisfy the curriculum threshold for units it covers; no manual override.

risks.risk: Content volume and Japanese naturalness cannot be validated by automation alone.
risks.mitigation: content_status taxonomy; naturalness checks flagged 'requires human review'; ship fewer, better items; allow user-reported issue export (local only).

risks.risk: Web Speech ja-JP voice absent or poor on some devices, especially offline.
risks.mitigation: Voice detection at startup; per-device capability banner; text-only fallbacks; optional audio packs later.

risks.risk: localStorage eviction/clearing loses progress; Safari 7-day rule for non-installed use.
risks.mitigation: Home Screen install guidance, export reminders, last-export timestamp, integrity check on boot.

risks.risk: CC BY-SA obligations from JMdict/KANJIDIC/KanjiVG data bundled into the repo.
risks.mitigation: Keep third-party data in separate attributed files; separate code license (MIT) and content license; provide Credits screen; legal check by owner before publishing.

risks.risk: Mock exams mistaken for official; scores over-interpreted.
risks.mitigation: Persistent 'practice estimate, not official' labeling; no 180-point conversion; section balance warning only as heuristic.

risks.risk: Service worker caching bugs strand users on stale builds or break sub-path routing.
risks.mitigation: Versioned cache name, precache manifest generated at build, skipWaiting only on user confirmation, relative URLs only, tests under /repo/ subpath.

risks.risk: Scope too large for one build run.
risks.mitigation: Phased implementation_plan with working vertical slice first (N5 unit 1 end-to-end) and gating checks.
Mark cultural notes draft_requires_fact_check; keep claims minimal and verifiable.

risks.risk: Pre-December 2020/2022 JLPT timing figures still circulate; implementers might copy outdated numbers.
risks.mitigation: Single source of truth in jlpt.levels with source S01 and last_verified date; test asserts values.

limitations.statement: Items below are explicit, user-visible limitations of release 1.0, not hidden gaps.

items.text: The 20-per-level target (100 total) is NOT met in release 1.0. Released count is reported per level in-app and in the repository README.
Learning audio is synthetic (device TTS). It is not native-speaker exam audio. Listening difficulty at N2/N1 (natural speed, multi-speaker) cannot be faithfully reproduced.
No pronunciation scoring. Recording is optional, local, and for self-comparison only.
No handwriting recognition. Stroke-order guidance and writing practice are self-assessed.
Content coverage differs by level (see content_coverage_plan). Levels with partial coverage show a coverage badge and must not claim exam completeness.
App results are practice estimates. They are not convertible to official scaled scores (official scores use equating; no public formula).
Non-installed Safari use can lose storage after 7 days without use; no automatic install prompt; background features unavailable.
Ambience is stylized/procedural unless verified recorded packs are added; it will not sound like a specific real place.
Reddit/community threads were not directly analyzed; learner-experience claims are low confidence.
No native-speaker review is available in this project by default; reviewed status requires a human reviewer.

content_coverage_plan.principle: Application functionality, curriculum coverage, exercise coverage, mock coverage, audio coverage and visual/destination coverage are reported separately. Functional features are never presented as content completeness.

reference_sizes_unofficial.note: Secondary-source estimates (S08). Not official JLPT specifications. N4 word count is an assumption.

curriculum_coverage.basis: design_decision; owner may raise or lower. Targets count items that passed at least auto_checked status.
curriculum_coverage.ui_rule: Each level shows 'Content released: X of Y planned units' and a 'foundation slice' badge where coverage is partial. The app must never state that a level is fully covered unless coverage_percent >= 95 against reference sizes and human_reviewed share >= 50 percent.

exercise_coverage.release_1: Every exercise type in exercise_types is implemented in the engine; each released grammar point has >= 6 distinct authored questions across >= 3 exercise types; each released unit has >= 1 listening and >= 1 reading activity.
exercise_coverage.generated_vs_authored: Templated generation (e.g. kana matching, number reading, particle fill-in from authored sentences) is allowed but each generated question must derive from a distinct source sentence/item; counts report authored and generated separately.

mock_examination_coverage.budget_note: Order-of-magnitude assumption for planning only; actual per-section item counts must be derived from the official sample materials (unresolved U-002).
mock_examination_coverage.feasibility_verdict: Engine: feasible. 20 distinct reviewed mocks per level in release 1.0: not feasible without a native reviewer and licensed or recorded audio. Plan: add batches of one mock per level per content batch; report released count per level in-app.
never_allowed: Shuffling the same items to create new mock IDs
Labeling generated papers as official or as past papers
Copying official workbook or commercial book questions

audio_coverage.release_1: Learning audio via Web Speech (synthetic, device-dependent). Ambience via procedural synthesis. Feedback sounds synthesized. No bundled third-party recordings unless asset_manifest verifies the license.
audio_coverage.later: Optional pre-generated audio packs for core vocabulary/dialogues, subject to U-001.

visual_destination_coverage.release_1: Stylized SVG map of all 9 regions; >= 27 destinations defined; full illustration + stamp + postcard for N5 destinations (10); simplified shared illustration templates with distinct icon/scene for N4-N1 destinations; revisit tiers defined for 8 hub destinations.
visual_destination_coverage.asset_budget: Total static assets (excluding fonts) <= 8 MB for the core pack; any single image <= 150 KB; SVG preferred.

user_journeys.name: First launch
steps: Open URL
See map with Tokyo as current destination
Tour (4 steps): journey idea, daily core session, audio opt-in, install/backup note
Tap Start today
Complete unit 1 lesson block (sounds + first hiragana row)
Earn first XP and Tokyo arrival stamp only after the lesson's retrieval check passes (>=70%)

user_journeys.name: Daily core session (30 min)
steps: Open Home
Tap Start today
Reviews (capped)
New material
Guided practice
Listening or reading
Destination quest step
Summary with next recommendation and optional extension

user_journeys.name: Return after a week away
steps: Open app
See friendly comeback card (no streak shaming)
Run 12-minute comeback session of highest-risk reviews
Resume current destination; backlog redistributed over next days

user_journeys.name: Unlock and visit a destination
steps: Prerequisite units met and review health OK
Destination changes locked -> available
Learner enters; completes quest; stamp and postcard animation (reduced-motion safe)
Journal updated; ambience offered, not auto-played

user_journeys.name: Revisit at higher level
steps: Level N4 unlocked
Tokyo Station tier n4 becomes available
Learner completes tier quest (short dialogue listening)
Tier stamp upgrade shown

user_journeys.name: Take a mock exam
steps: JLPT hub -> level -> Mock
Pre-check: voice availability, time, quiet environment
Timed sections per official lengths
Submit -> practice estimate and weak areas
Weak areas feed next daily plan

user_journeys.name: Back up and move device
steps: Profile -> Backup -> Export JSON
On new device open app -> Import
See preview (counts, dates) and overwrite warning
Confirm -> restored; success message; verify progress

user_journeys.name: Go offline
steps: First online visit completes core precache (status indicator turns 'Ready offline')
Turn on airplane mode
Open app from home screen
Lessons, map, reviews work; unavailable optional packs shown as 'not downloaded'

user_journeys.name: Level unlock
steps: N5 curriculum threshold reached
Readiness check and N5 milestone practice exam available
Pass internal criteria -> N4 hub unlocked
Message states this is internal progress, not JLPT certification

units.focus: Past polite, dates, days of week

lesson_structure: goal statement ('why this matters' tied to a destination)
curriculum.cross_skill_rule: Each unit must include vocabulary, grammar, listening, reading and one real-world scenario; kanji introduced only after their component vocabulary has appeared in kana form or with furigana.

kana_policy.stroke_order_source: KanjiVG-derived SVG (CC BY-SA 3.0) if license accepted by owner; otherwise original simplified stroke guides

kanji_policy.confusables: authored pairs, surfaced by confusion detection

curriculum.sequencing_rule: A concept may only appear in learner-facing content after its prerequisite concept ids are introduced (enforced by validator).
curriculum.spiral_review_rule: Old items reappear in new sentences, dialogues, passages and destination quests; at least 20 percent of items in each unit's exercises must come from earlier units.

design_principles: Deterministic: same state + same date + same config = same plan
Explainable: every plan block carries a reason_code and learner-facing text
Testable: each rule has an ID and unit tests

rules.name: Backlog safety
rules.then: enter backlog_mode: schedule only the review_cap lowest-retrievability due facets; defer the rest across the next 7 days with per-day cap; suppress new material this session; show reason.

rules.name: Leech handling
rules.then: tag leech; insert a context rewrite or mnemonic card; split into easier sub-facet; reduce frequency to avoid grinding; offer 'park for 7 days'.

rules.name: Confusion contrast
rules.then: insert contrast exercise (A vs B) in guided practice; add pair to confusables list; clear counter after 3 consecutive correct contrasts.

rules.name: Due reviews
rules.then: add up to review_cap facets sorted by (1 - retrievability) desc, then overdue_days desc; bury sibling facets of the same concept from adjacency.

rules.name: New material gate
rules.when: not backlog_mode and due_ratio <= gate and recent_accuracy >= gate
rules.then: teach next lesson in current unit; new item counts per defaults, scaled by minutes setting and recent accuracy (reduce 30 percent if accuracy < 0.8).

rules.name: Modality gap
rules.when: text accuracy minus listen accuracy >= gap over min attempts
rules.then: add listening drills on the same items.

rules.name: Construction gap
rules.then: add sentence construction and ordering exercises for the grammar point.

rules.name: Destination quest step
rules.when: destination available/in_progress and quest step eligible
rules.then: add one quest step using material from current and recent units; include spiral items from earlier units.

rules.name: Exam proximity
rules.then: reserve exam_proximity_share of session minutes for exam-style practice for the target level; keep reviews intact.

rules.name: Mastered reduction
rules.then: only SRS schedule applies; do not re-teach; spiral appearances reduced to <= 1 per 3 weeks.

rules.name: Revisit suggestion
rules.when: destination has unfinished tier for an unlocked level OR average retrievability of destination-tagged items < 0.80
rules.then: suggest destination revisit as optional block.

rules.name: Optional extension
rules.then: append extension_blocks_to_60 in priority order; never labeled as required.

missed_days.gap_3_7: comeback session: <= 15 highest-risk reviews (~12 min), no new items until done; friendly copy; progress intact
missed_days.gap_gt_7: welcome-back: <= 20 reviews by lowest retrievability, then re-enter plan; remaining overdue facets spread over next 7 days with per-day cap

destination_unlock_algorithm: 1. A destination is visible_locked if its first_visit_level is the current level or the next level; otherwise hidden.
2. It becomes discoverable when >= 60 percent of its prerequisite units' lessons are complete.
3. It becomes available only when level_unlocked is true AND all_units_completed are complete.
4. It becomes in_progress when the learner starts its first quest.
5. It becomes completed when completion.units_completed are done AND the primary quest meets min accuracy.
6. It becomes revisit_available when a higher level unlocks and an unfinished tier exists for that destination.

Strings only, about 5 MB per origin (S10); some engines count UTF-16 so assume an effective worst case of about 2.5 million characters
Not accessible from service workers or web workers (S10)
Safari 7-day cap applies to non-installed Safari use (S11)
Browsers may evict origin data under storage pressure; clearing site data erases it

completed lesson ids, unit states, level states, current destination, destination states
arrays of compact facet records, up to 500 per shard
per-concept mastery summaries, confusion pair counters, leech flags
ring buffer of last 3000 attempt records plus aggregate counters
attempt summaries (<= 200) and in-progress attempt state

size_estimates.method: facet record about 40 bytes JSON; facets per concept: ~3 for vocab/kanji, ~2 for grammar, ~2 for kana
size_estimates.verdict: Viable for release 1.0 with large headroom. At full N1 coverage it approaches half of the effective worst-case quota, so mitigations are specified in advance.

mitigations_before_any_change_of_storage: integer content indices instead of string ids
archive records for items with stability >= 365 days into a packed array of 12-byte-equivalent tuples
prompt export and reset of old attempts

thresholds.action: show Storage health card, compaction, export prompt

write_policy.multi_key_writes: write txn marker listing keys, apply, clear marker; on boot, if marker exists, validate each key and repair or quarantine
write_policy.quota_error: catch QuotaExceededError, run compaction once, retry, then show blocking export prompt without discarding in-memory state

integrity.parse_failure: never silently reset; move raw value to jla:v1:quarantine:<key>:<timestamp> (size-capped) and load defaults for that domain with a visible notice and export option

versioning_and_migration.migrations: pure functions vN -> vN+1 in src/core/migrations with unit tests and fixtures from real prior versions
versioning_and_migration.pre_migration: snapshot raw data to jla:v1:premigrate:vN if space, else block migration and require export
versioning_and_migration.failure: stop, keep old data untouched, show recovery screen with export

local_storage.concurrency: storage event listener; if another tab changes data, reload state and show notice; mock attempts allowed in one tab only
local_storage.unavailable_storage: If localStorage throws (private mode or blocked), run in memory with a persistent banner and prompt to export frequently
local_storage.backup_reminders: Show non-blocking reminder when last export > 14 days or after 7 study days since last export; on iOS non-installed Safari remind about install

fields: data: settings, progress, srs shards, concepts, attempts (trimmed), exams, journal, meta without installId secrets

export.method: Blob + anchor download; if navigator.canShare with files is available offer Share; verify behavior in installed iOS PWA (U-009b)
export.records: updates lastExportAt after the file is produced

import_steps: 1. User picks a .json file (size limit 5 MB).
3. Validate format, formatVersion, checksum and domain schemas; unknown newer formatVersion is refused with a clear message; older versions are migrated in memory.
4. Show preview: exportedAt, app/content version, counts (units completed, facets, stamps, mock attempts), last activity date, compared against current data.
5. Show overwrite warning; require checkbox confirmation.
6. Snapshot current data to a pre-import backup key (if space) or prompt to export first.
7. Apply through the txn mechanism; read back and verify.
8. Show success or failure; on failure roll back to snapshot.
backup_restore.orphan_handling: Ids not present in the current content are kept and flagged orphaned; never deleted.
backup_restore.merge_mode: MAY: newest-per-record merge; not required for release 1.0
backup_restore.privacy: Never uploaded; the file is created and read on the device only.

offline_architecture.principle: Claim offline readiness only after verification: compare Cache Storage keys to the build's precache manifest and show 'Ready offline' or the list of missing items.
offline_architecture.routing: Hash routing (#/path) to avoid GitHub Pages 404 on deep links; no server rewrites are needed.
precache: content index and released unit JSON for the starting level (N5) and all level indexes
map SVG and N5 destination scenes
lazy_cached: content JSON for N4-N1 units (cache-first after first fetch)

strategies.navigation: network-first with timeout, fallback to cached index.html

service_worker.update_flow: New worker installs and waits; UI shows 'Update ready' toast with Refresh button; skipWaiting only on user confirmation; activation deletes old caches; user data in localStorage untouched.
service_worker.install_failure: If any required precache asset fails, installation fails and the previous version continues; UI shows 'Offline not ready' with retry.
service_worker.range_requests: Safari may require HTTP Range support for media served by a service worker; implement 206 responses for cached audio packs and test on iPhone (U-008).

failure_handling: fetch failure for non-cached content shows 'Not available offline yet' not a blank screen
mock exams require their question files; they are precached per level only after user taps 'Download level for offline' or when first opened online

offline_architecture.app_shell_vs_content: Release 1.0 precache target <= 8 MB (assets budget); N4-N1 content is delivered on demand but flagged in status until cached.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Repository and CI contain no paid service, API key, or paid-plan dependency; the deploy workflow uses only GitHub Pages and public registries.
Code search finds no network call to any model/AI API and no personalization path that is not a pure function of local data.
The build output contains only static files; no server code, hosted database client or account/login UI exists.
Every visual and brand asset is listed in the asset manifest with origin original/owner-supplied; none depicts a third-party mascot or logo (human review H-check).
App loads and all assets resolve when served at /<repo>/ with no console 404s.
After first online load completes, the offline indicator reads Ready offline only if all precache manifest entries exist in Cache Storage.
With network disabled, learner can open the app, complete a lesson, a review, and see the map.
Zero cross-origin network requests during a full journey.
All progress and settings persist in localStorage across reload; no IndexedDB use exists in the codebase.
Total user-state storage after simulating 5000 facets and 3000 attempts is <= 1 MB (UTF-16 counted).
Corrupted localStorage value is quarantined, not deleted; app starts with a notice.
Schema migration from fixture v1 to latest preserves all records; failed migration leaves data untouched.
Export then import on a clean profile reproduces progress; preview and confirmation appear; invalid file leaves data unchanged.
N5-N1 are navigable; each level shows released units, coverage badge, and unlock criteria with live values.
Level N4 cannot be unlocked without meeting the configured criteria; no UI path bypasses it.
A destination cannot become available unless its unlock conditions are met even if its parent is completed.
Map renders from SVG with no external requests, <= 120 KB, and a list-view alternative.
27 destinations exist across 9 regions with valid prerequisites referencing existing units; route has no cycles.
Stamps and postcards are awarded only after completion evidence and never duplicate on replay or import.
Ambience is off by default, requires a user gesture, ducks/pauses around learning audio, and persists settings.
With no ja-JP voice, audio exercises switch to transcript mode with a visible notice.
Recording works only after tapping Record; no network request carries audio; the app is fully usable with permission denied.
Handwriting exercises display a self-assessed label; no recognition claims exist in UI text.
SRS passes reference-vector tests (or the fallback scheduler passes its documented table tests); planner is deterministic given state and clock.
Missed 4 days produces a comeback session of <= 15 reviews and no new items.
Mastery never reaches proficient from a single session.
Mock sections use the minutes in jlpt.levels; mock results show practice percent only and the 'practice estimate' label; no /180 score appears anywhere.
Each shipped mock passes distinctness validators; no question id is shared between mocks; draft questions are excluded.
UI and README state the exact number of released mocks per level versus the target of 20.
No placeholder text (lorem ipsum, TODO, 'coming soon' presented as content) appears in shipped content files.
Every third-party asset has a manifest entry with an allowed license; disallowed or missing entries fail the build.
Content status badges (draft/auto_checked/human_reviewed) and per-level coverage percentages are visible and computed from the manifest.
axe scan finds no serious or critical violations on all screens; keyboard-only completion of a lesson and a mock section is possible.
Reduced-motion setting removes non-essential animation.
Touch targets >= 44x44 CSS px in lesson, review and exam screens.
Readiness shows 'Not enough data yet' under 20 attempts and never labels itself a JLPT score.
Exam-date planner never promises passing and shows the not-realistic message when pace_ratio < 0.6.
Official facts in the app (times, pass marks, item types) equal jlpt.levels and show their source and verification date.
Install works on Android Chrome; iPhone Home Screen install instructions are shown; iOS limitations are documented in-app.
